ComponentIdentifier.description: The identifier the device reports for the component in its firmware parameters.

Name.description: The name of the component. A consumer may use it as a D-Bus object path element and as the component's update target, so it must be unique in the system. A configuration that is probed more than once can keep it unique with a template such as $bus.

FirmwareComponents.description: The firmware components of the device that have a name. Each ComponentIdentifier and each Name appears once.

Name.description: The Name of the MCTP record of the PLDM firmware device, in the same configuration. Records of one configuration that share a Name are published on one object.
